integrity: Finite checks have been performed against the bundled verifier and support, but do not replace, the symbolic proof; original priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-n result for non-induced motif counts in independent-edge G(n,p); sparse expansion for fixed H and k. Does not address induced motifs, fixed-edge ensembles, growing motifs, or independent historical priority. Existing degree-count and motif-count marginal theories remain prior work.
title: An ordered single-crossing law for motif–degree covariance in binomial random graphs
